description: Ask a named person to approve, reject or amend something, on WhatsApp, and wait for their answer. Use this before doing anything that is expensive or impossible to undo: issuing a refund, sending a quote, posting publicly, emailing a list, deleting data. The person gets buttons on their phone and can also reply with free text to amend what you proposed. Returns their decision, or the request id if nobody has answered yet.

allow_amendment.description: Offer an Edit button that asks for free text. Use it when the answer could reasonably be 'yes but change this' rather than only yes or no.

body.description: Why you are asking, and anything they need in order to decide.

expires_in_minutes.description: How long the decision stays useful. Defaults to a day.

external_id.description: Your own id for the thing being decided. Sending the same one twice returns the existing request rather than asking a second time, so a retry is safe.

title.description: The decision, in one line. 'Refund AED 450 to Sara'.

url.description: A link to the thing being decided.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for an answer before returning. Defaults to 120. Pass 0 to return immediately and poll with check_approval.

name: ask_person
title: Ask a person to approve something on WhatsApp
